-- products in stock vs out of stock
SET mrp = CASE WHEN mrp IS NOT NULL THEN mrp / 100.0 ELSE NULL END,
discountedSellingPrice = CASE WHEN discountedSellingPrice IS NOT NULL THEN discountedSellingPrice / 100.0 ELSE NULL END;
SELECT DISTINCT TOP (10) name, mrp, discountPercent
-- Q2. High MRP but out of stock
ORDER BY mrp DESC, discountPercent DESC;
